theorem point_cost (H : S.Hierarchy) (i : Axis) (A : Weight L) (e) (Q : Finset Axis)
    (hi : i∈Q) (he : Mixed Q e) (hp : ∀ i∈Q,Pressed i A) (hk : ∀ i∈Q,Own A i (e i))
    (w : Axis→ℝ) (hw : ∀ i∈Q,w i≤0) (q : ℝ) (hq : q<0) (f : Grouping) (hf : Colors Q f)
    (δ : ℝ) (hd : 0<δ) : Budget δ (fun n => ∫ p,cost i Q (fuel q n) (mails w f n) p ∂ν (V i) A) := by

proof_context.conclusion: For `i` in `Q`, with both signs present (`Mixed`), pressed words with parity signs `Own`, widths `w_j <= 0`, `q<0`, even nonnegative profiles (`Colors`) and `δ>0`, `∫ cost i Q (fuel q n) (mails w f n) p ∂ν (V i) A` is `Budget δ`, where `cost` is `1_{E<=1}/(E+λ^q)` times the product of the transverse profiles over `Q.erase i`.
